speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your symptoms: has the fever and flank pain started after you finished the antibiotics for your sinusitis, or did they appear while you were still taking them? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood, cloudiness, or foul odor?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis (likely ascending UTI secondary to recent antibiotic use or misdiagnosed initial infection). I suspect the flank pain and fever indicate a kidney infection rather than a relapse of sinusitis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture & Sensitivity. REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound.
